svg.text: EF101-P11 Computer Hardware Inventory and Maintenance System: project schema
Everything runs on one computer. No Internet needed: no external libraries are used.
plain CSS; light and dark themes;
COUNT / GROUP BY for totals and
charts (all add up to the total)
a blank box keeps the total
db.py: get_db() opens inventory.db with foreign keys ON; init_db() runs schema.sql
no cost: it lives in assets.status_cost
What happens when you press Save
Errors: the form is shown again with messages, nothing is saved
OK: a parameterised INSERT writes the row, then commit()
Redirect to the asset page: a SELECT shows the new record
Dashboard and CSV export read the same tables
A fault stays open as steps (no history yet); setting the PC Operational
writes ONE history entry with every step and the single Updated Cost.
Retiring an asset sets active = 0: it disappears from lists but its history stays.
Project files and what each one does
backend: routes, validation, CSV export (no SQL)
opens SQLite; CREATE TABLE for all four tables
upgrades an older inventory.db, keeps all data
makes 40 demo assets + 43 events (fixed random seed)
automated checks on a temporary database
how to run, rules, tool and AI disclosure
Outputs: dashboard (totals, charts, most failing asset) and CSV downloads that open in Excel.
